canon-the-expanse:ilus.x: Lithium-rich extrasolar world beyond the Ring Gates settled by Belter refugees and Royal Charter Energy in Cibola Burn.
canon-the-expanse:ilus.a: James S. A. Corey (Daniel Abraham & Ty Franck)

hip-27989.x: Origin system of Ford Prefect (Betelgeuse VII) and Zaphod Beeblebrox (Betelgeuse V), 640 light-years distant.
hip-27989.w: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy

gaia-4722135642226902656.x: Exomoon of Calpamos in the Zeta-2 Reticuli system where USCSS Nostromo discovers the derelict Engineer vessel and Xenomorph eggs in Alien (1979) and Hadley’s Hope in Aliens (1986).
gaia-4722135642226902656.a: Dan O’Bannon / Ronald Shusett / Ridley Scott

mercury.x: Vast city mounted on thermal-expansion tracks that rolls continuously around Mercury’s equator to stay inside the habitable twilight zone.
Scientific observation base and headquarters of Project Spaceguard tracking the 50-kilometer alien cylinder Rama during its perihelion slingshot.
Expedition site where humans uncover the solar system counterpart to the Proxima Hatch wormhole doorway.
Inner planets dismantled into dense computational nodes and solar-sail smart matter enclosing the Sun as humanity transcends into the Singularity.
Deep subterranean caverns where the glowing, paper-thin Harmonium creatures live on melodic vibrations and solar energy.
Heavily shielded subterranean polar station on Mercury coordinating human and alien expeditions diving deep into the solar chromosphere.
mercury.a: Gregory Benford, David Brin, Walter M. Miller Jr.

neptune.x: Outer Solar System orbital boundary where the antimatter-pulsing Lima Project antenna threatens Earth in Ad Astra, and the reappearance site of the hell-dimension test ship Event Horizon.

pioneer-11.x: First spacecraft to encounter Saturn (1979); escaping the Solar System toward the constellation Scutum and Aquila.
